title: A greenhouse
checked: Every reachable state checked (5 states, 11 with their data, 22 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 5 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.

rules.rule: Never two hours in a red band
rules.says: Under 10 °C or over 30 °C, the heater or the vent is working by the second hour.
rules.path: Take away the first hour guard and it breaks in 3 steps: night falls, wait an hour, wait an hour.

rules.rule: The heater and the vent are never on together
rules.says: Heat is never let straight out of an open vent.
rules.path: Take away the vent is shut guard and it breaks in 4 steps: sun comes out, open vent, night falls, heater on.
